title: centaurea nigra subsp. rivularis
intro: Centaurea nigra subsp. rivularis, commonly known as River knapweed, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family, characterized by its tall stature and vibrant purple flowers. It is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, skin issues, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of River knapweed include analgesic, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects, which can help alleviate pain, muscle spasms, and fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
